findings.title: Source receipts do not bind the finalized artifacts or transport observations
findings.evidence: Eleven receipt artifactSha256 values differ from both the actual files and the operative ledger sourceRegistry: epstein-2026, epstein-2025, studentview, dawson, fcdw, peo, medical-page, peo-about, jenne-page, jenne-community and police-page. For example, the epstein-2026 receipt records d305702ca34a64e812934c7404a9b8c5419e90c947cbd091735c7f826ed8e19a, while the actual finalized artifact and ledger record 69b7d18bff3f2562b4ef39d8346268da506fc1038c3f976aed91e07a38d1ffb0. The fcdw-2026, jenne and vfw receipts also assert HTTP 200 while the operative ledger correctly records an unknown exact HTTP status, successful transport exit and its limit. The builder updates sources in memory but never saves those updates to source-receipts.json; verify.py does not compare that file with the ledger.
findings.action: Finalize source-receipts.json from the same source objects used by the ledger. Require structural equality with sourceRegistry and independently verify every artifact hash and the three transport-status limitations. Preserve the rejected candidate and regenerate the replacement manifest.

findings.title: Sanitization substitutes inferred submission destinations into source text
findings.evidence: The actual Fellows page says to turn the application in to a named recipient by 4/30/2026; it does not print WHS Guidance Office. The sanitized artifact substitutes that office, and bound evidence excerpts inherit the substitution. Collinsworth similarly changes the printed named guidance counselor into WHS guidance counselor. Emily, Quatman and Community Service explicitly print WHS Guidance Office, but those separate sources do not establish the Fellows route.
findings.action: Replace omitted names with explicit redaction markers without adding a school or office. Retain the printed dates and roles, keep unsupported submission-route provenance held, and refresh affected excerpts and hashes. Check the other sanitized transcripts for equivalent inference presented as source text.

findings.title: Historical medical artifact retains a contact address despite the stated sanitization scope
findings.evidence: The historical medical artifact retains the provider postal address, and the historicalAlias evidence excerpt repeats it. README, validation and source extraction limits say contact values were omitted. This is a public provider contact rather than an applicant response or applicant PII, but the packet's sanitization claim is inaccurate.
findings.action: Omit the postal contact value using an explicit marker, preserve the organization, submission method and deadline, and update every affected excerpt and hash.

findings.title: Log-normalization descriptions omit removal of leading blank lines
findings.evidence: The receipts say only trailing whitespace and EOF blank lines were normalized. Independently reconstructing the recorded originalOutputSha256 values requires restoring one leading newline to every command log; typecheck additionally requires restoring its second terminal newline. Commands, exit codes, substantive output and timestamps are not contradicted.
findings.action: Correct each normalization description to include leading blank-line removal. Preserve original-output hashes, finalized-log hashes, commands, timestamps and exit codes.
